name: Puffin Rinse
tagline: Industrial-grade clean, engineered for the way one person actually lives.
positioning: Puffin Rinse brings warehouse-caliber cleaning systems, refills, and know-how to prosumers and households who refuse to settle for hardware-store spray bottles.

hero.h1: The clean the pros use, finally sized for your kitchen.
hero.sub: Puffin Rinse turns commercial-grade degreasers, foamers, and micro-scrub tooling into a tidy subscription — dosed, dilution-mapped, and delivered before you run out.

features.title: Warehouse chemistry, home doses
features.description: Concentrates borrowed from food-plant sanitation lines, pre-portioned so a single capsule fills your bottle. No goggles-and-guesswork dilution math.

features.title: Surface-smart routing
features.description: Tell us your floors, hobs, and grout and we ship only the formulas that won't etch, cloud, or strip them. Bespoke, not one-bottle-fits-all.

features.title: Never-run-out refills
features.description: Our usage model watches your cadence and reships pods days before empty. The junk drawer of half-used sprays becomes one calm shelf.

features.title: Rinse Playbooks
features.description: Step-by-step routines for the jobs you dread — oven carbon, shower film, garage epoxy — written by facility cleaners, not influencers.

features.title: Return-and-refill loop
features.description: Aluminum bottles come back to us in a prepaid pouch, get sanitized, and re-enter the flock. Zero single-use plastic in the whole chain.

features.title: Streak-free guarantee
features.description: If a formula haze, film, or fails to lift the grime we mapped it to, the next shipment is on us. We stand behind the shine.

testimonials.quote: I restore vintage motorcycles in a two-car garage. Puffin Rinse ships me the same degreaser I used at a fleet depot, but in doses that don't take up a whole wall. My driveway has never looked so serious.
testimonials.name: Marcus Devlin

testimonials.quote: We run a five-suite Airbnb portfolio ourselves. The surface routing meant no more ruined marble vanities from the wrong spray. Turnovers are faster and the reviews stopped mentioning 'chemical smell.'
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: I hated that my sink was a graveyard of near-empty bottles. Now one shelf, one system, and refills that show up before I even think about it. It feels absurdly futuristic for mopping.
testimonials.name: Theo Braun

pricing.blurb: For one tidy home and the person who refuses grimy grout.
For big homes, garages, and prosumers cleaning like a small crew.
For short-let hosts and side-hustle operators juggling many spaces.

homepage.footerBlurb: Puffin Rinse is on a mission to make professional-grade clean the default for everyone — one refillable bottle, one perfectly dosed pod at a time.
